en.instruksi: Count the sides around the outside. Pick the shape with the number of sides asked for.
en.i-segitiga-merah-tepi: Solid red. Trace the outside edge by moving down-right, left, then up-right back to the start.
en.i-rambu-segitiga-tepi: Yellow outline. Trace the outside edge by moving down-right, left, then up-right back to the start.
en.i-segitiga-biru-tepi: Tilted blue. Trace the outside edge by moving down-right, down-left, then up-right back to the start.
en.i-segitiga-hijau-kecil-tepi: Small green. Trace the outside edge by moving down-right, left, then up-right back to the start.
en.i-persegi-biru-tepi: Solid blue. Trace the outside edge by moving right, down, left, then up back to the start.
en.i-persegi-hijau-tepi: Solid green. Trace the outside edge by moving right, down, left, then up back to the start.
en.i-belah-ketupat-oranye-tepi: Tilted orange. Trace the outside edge by moving down-right, down-left, up-left, then up-right back to the start.
en.i-persegi-panjang-kuning-tepi: Wide yellow. Trace the outside edge by moving right, down, left, then up back to the start.
en.i-segi-lima-penuh-tepi: Solid purple. Trace the outside edge by moving down-right, down-left, left, up-left, then up-right back to the start.
en.i-segi-lima-kosong-tepi: Purple outline. Trace the outside edge by moving down-right, down-left, left, up-left, then up-right back to the start.
en.i-segi-enam-penuh-tepi: Solid dark blue. Trace the outside edge by moving right, down-right, down-left, left, up-left, then up-right back to the start.
en.i-segi-enam-kosong-tepi: Teal outline. Trace the outside edge by moving right, down-right, down-left, left, up-left, then up-right back to the start.
en.i-segi-enam-tidur-tepi: Flat orange. Trace the outside edge by moving right, down-right, down-left, left, up-left, then up-right back to the start.
en.i-rambu-berhenti-tepi: Solid dark red. Trace the outside edge by moving right, down-right, down, down-left, left, up-left, up, then up-right back to the start.
